item.gloss: How are you brother?
Fine Mister.
What's your name?
My name is Smith.
Smith, and my name is George.
How are you?
Fine. When did you leave Kenya?
I left Kenya last month.

item.IPA_transcription: Mwezi jana, nzuri. Mimi pia nish ishi hapa sasa karibu miaka mwili.
item.gloss: Last month, that's good. I have been here for about two years.

item.IPA_transcription: Miaka miwili, sasa wewe umeshakoa muamericano.
item.gloss: Two years! Now you have become an American.

item.IPA_transcription: Bado sijakuwa Muamerica. Atanafikiri sitaki-kuwa Muamerica.
item.gloss: Not yet, I haven't become an American and I don't want to be one.
Is that so

item.IPA_transcription: Safari yako kutoka Kenya ili kwaje?
item.gloss: How was your trip from Kenya?

item.IPA_transcription: Safari ilikuwa nzuri. Nilichukua karibu saa ishirini-na-moja kufika hapa.
item.gloss: The trip was fine. It took me twenty-one hours to get here.
What route did you take to get here?

item.IPA_transcription: Nilichukua ila Kenya Airways mpaka London halafo nikachukua British-Airways mpaka hapa.
item.gloss: I took Kenya-Airways to London and then took British-Airways to here.
Was the journey fine?
It was very good.

item.IPA_transcription: Mimi-pia nilichukua safari kama yako. Kutoka Kenya mpaka ulaya wa kutoka ulaya mpaka hapa America.
item.gloss: I took a similar trip too. From Kenya to England and then from England to America.

item.IPA_transcription: Lakini unajua kwamba mimi nilipofika huko kwa airport
item.gloss: But do you know that when I arrived at the airport
where?

item.IPA_transcription: Hapa airport ya L.A. nika pata wakora wengene bwana waka ni nyanganya dola sitini bwana.
item.gloss: Here at L.A. I met some con-men who tricked sixty dollars out of me.
How did they do it?

item.IPA_transcription: Ati hiyo ni feya ya hapa. Kutoka airport mpaka hapa bwana.
item.gloss: They said that the fare from the airport to here is that amount.
Were they taxi drivers?
yes

item.IPA_transcription: Pangine walijua kwamba wewe si Mwaamerica.
item.gloss: Probably they found out that you were not an American.

item.IPA_transcription: Niliwambia mimi si Mwaamerica. Nilisema mimi ni mgani. Nilitaka wani lete huko kwa Student Center.
item.gloss: I told them that I was not an American. I told them that I was guest here and I wanted to go to the Student Center.

item.IPA_transcription: Hapa lazima ujichunge. Kuna wakora wengi sana hapa.
item.gloss: You must take care here since there are a lot of con men around

item.IPA_transcription: Sikujua. Nilifikiri hawajamaa wanaweza kuwa waminifu.
item.gloss: I did not know that. I thought that these people would be trustworthy.

item.IPA_transcription: Hapa ni mahali mbaya sana. Mimi-pia siku nilifika hapa. Kwanza nilikaa airport nakuangalia vile vitu viliandelea. Halafu bahati yangu nili pata Mama mzee anafanya kazi kule. Alinisaidia. Alinitafutia taxi driver.
item.gloss: This could be a very bad place. The day I arrived here, I had to sit at the airport and watch what was going on. Luckily I found a woman who worked there who found me a good Taxi driver.

item.IPA_transcription: Sasa katika hii miaka umesha kuwa hapa unaonate?
item.gloss: Since these years that you have been here, how do you like it here?

item.IPA_transcription: Vitu zina endelea vizuri, darasa zangu zina endelea vizuri. Na poa tu na maisha. Natafuta kazi. Nikipata kazi takuwa njema. Yani nipate pesa ya-kutumia hivo-na-hivo.
item.gloss: Things are going on good. My classes are going on well and I am just cooling off. I am looking for a job. If I get a job would be fine so that I can get the money to spend here and there.
Is that so
How are your classes going on?

item.IPA_transcription: Zina endelea vizuri. Isopokua nimeshakua na tabu ya nyumba. Sasa nimepata nyumba na sasa nafikiri nitakaa vizuri nisome.
item.gloss: They are going on just fine. I had a problem of housing but since I have found a place to live, I think I am going to live well.

item.IPA_transcription: Sasa umepata nyumba, unakaa pekeyako ama unaishi na rafiki?
item.gloss: Now since you have a place to live, do you live alone or do you have a room-mate?

item.IPA_transcription: Sasa naishi pekeyangu. Hiyo ndiyo mimi nikuwa natafuta.
item.gloss: I live alone. That's what I wanted.
That's fine. How's the rent?

item.IPA_transcription: Huko mahali nilipokua juzi nilikuwa nilikuwa pesa mingi sana. Lakini sasa nimeongeza pesa kidogo na sasa nina nyumba yote kubwa kwangu.
item.gloss: Where I used to live before was expensive but now I pay a little more but I have the whole place for myself.
Does it have a kitchen and a living-room?
It has everything.

item.IPA_transcription: Nzuri. Ina viombo ama unataka nununua viombo?
item.gloss: Do you have utensils or are you going to buy them?
I have bought important ones.
You have plates and pots?
Those I have.
Chairs?
Chairs too.
Bed too?
Even a bed.

item.IPA_transcription: Basi sasa umesha poa kidogo naona.
item.gloss: Now I see that you can relax.

item.IPA_transcription: Nimesha poa sana. Nafikiri sasa ninaona kama nimesha anza kuishi.
item.gloss: I have relaxed. I see that I have started to live now.

item.IPA_transcription: Usha-anza kufahamu Los Angeles? Usha-anza kutembea hapa na pale?
item.gloss: Are you getting familiar with L.A.? Have you started visiting the different places here and there?

item.IPA_transcription: Matambezi ndiyo sijafanya sana. Kwamana ilikuwa nafikiri kutembea lazima uwe kama ushkaa vizuri.
item.gloss: I have started traveling. I think that one has to live well before one can go about visiting places.

item.IPA_transcription: Ndiyo, lazima kama usha kaa vizuri, sasa mafikiro zingene zita potea uki-kaa vizuri.
item.gloss: Yes, one must live well in order to get rid of the different problems.

item.IPA_transcription: Nafikiri vile, sasa ndiyo nataka kuanza matembezi vizuri.
item.gloss: Yes, I think so, it's now that I want to go about visiting places.
Have you made a lot of friends?
I think that I will visit you soon.

item.IPA_transcription: Lazima sasa nikueleze mahali nina ishi.
item.gloss: I must show you where I live.
So that we can eat chicken.

item.IPA_transcription: Ndiyo, lazima. Atamahali nakaa ni karibu na beach. Lazima saa ngina tutembea kule.
item.gloss: Yes, I live close to the beach. We could go for a walk there.

item.IPA_transcription: Ndiyo, tutembea kwa beach. Huko beach iko namna ngani? Wewe ushatembea kule?
item.gloss: Yes, we could walk at the beach. How is it at the beach? Do you go there often?

item.IPA_transcription: Karibu na kwangu, kwanza jumamosi na juma-pili ukienda kula, kuna watu wengi sana.
item.gloss: It's close to where I live. Haven't you been there? [Not yet] You must come to my place over the weekend, since there are many people there.
Is that true
Yes, there are lots of people.
I think that I will visit you.

item.IPA_transcription: Shouri iki-fika jumamosi ama ama jumapili nzuri. Shouri watu wengi hawaendi kazini. Watu wanaenda beach kupoa.
item.gloss: Since a lot of people don't go to work during the weekends, people go to the beach to relax.

item.IPA_transcription: Naona watu hapa hawaendi kazini jumamosi.
item.gloss: I see here that people don't go to work on Saturdays.

item.IPA_transcription: Watu wengi hawafanyi kazi shouri lazima watu pia wa pumzike. Ukifanya kazi kutoka Jumatatu paka Ijuma, unachoka. Hata mimi inkienda shule paka Ijuma Ninachoka.
item.gloss: A lot of people don't work and they try to relax. If you work from Monday to Friday you get tired. Even I get tired going to school from Monday to Friday.

item.IPA_transcription: Hawa jamaa washa pona bwana. Kwamana hulo myumbani unafanya kazi kila siku.
item.gloss: People here are lucky because at home one has to work every day.
So now you too can relax.
I am trying to.
Any more news from Kenya?
Kenya!
Must have been alright.

item.IPA_transcription: Nafikiri kila kitu kinaendelea viema. Isopokua tabu kidogo, kidogo. Lakini hiyo iko kila-mahali.
item.gloss: I think everything is going on well. Except for the few problems here and there. But that's found everywhere.

item.IPA_transcription: Tabu ya hapa na plae iko kila-mahali
item.gloss: Problems of here and there are everywhere.
yes

item.IPA_transcription: Sasa mimi nisha ishi hapa miaka miwili. Ninataka kujaribu kwenda Kenya nyumbani mwaka ngene.
item.gloss: Since I have been here for over two years, I want to go to Kenya next year.
When will you finish your course?

item.IPA_transcription: Coursi yangu bado ita chukua miaka moja-na-nusu ngine.
item.gloss: My course will take another year and a half.
You said that tou are studying mathematics.
I am studying mathematics and computers.

item.IPA_transcription: Unasoma computer, siku ile utafika nyumbani utapata kazi.
item.gloss: You are studying computers. The day you go home you will find a job easily.

item.IPA_transcription: Hata mimi naomba mungu nipate kazi niki fika nyumbani.
item.gloss: Even I am praying that I get a job when I go home.

item.IPA_transcription: Tuna watu wachache nyumbani wanasoma computer.
item.gloss: There are a few people at home studying computers.
Probably there are a few computers.

item.IPA_transcription: Lakani siku-izi kuna wengi. Nina fikiri ukifika kule utapata kila kitu iko.
item.gloss: These days there are many. By the time you get there, you will find everything.

item.IPA_transcription: Pia naona saa hapa. Una fikiri kama ishapita dakika kumi.
item.gloss: I can see the time here. Do you think that ten minutes are over?

item.IPA_transcription: Lakini hawa jamaa wana taka nini?
item.gloss: But what do these people want?

item.IPA_transcription: Hawa watu wana-taka kujua vile luga inaendelea. Vile watu wanazungumza. Unafikiri dakika kumi ishapita?
item.gloss: They want to know how the language goes on. The way people talk. Do you think ten minutes are over?
I think it's close. (to ten minutes)

item.IPA_transcription: Niki maliza hapa ninataka kusoma nina imtihani jumatatu.
item.gloss: When I am over with this, I want to go and study. I have an exam on Monday.
Even I have left my class.
I think that the time is over.
Does he say so?
yes.

item.IPA_transcription: Hiyo mzuri bwana. Haya kwa heri.
item.gloss: That's fine. Good bye.
Goodbye.
Thank you.
Thank you.
